text_description: A runway look shown from upper torso to feet, built around a coordinated dark woven-striped set: a boxy open-front jacket or vest in a textured navy ground with dense vertical multicolor striping, worn over a fitted knit-looking top with a pale cream center panel and deep burgundy vertical bands. A black belt or waistband detail with a gold interlocking-style metal buckle sits high at the front, visually separating the top from the trousers. The trousers are high-waisted with visible belt loops, a center button, front fly area, and side pockets where the hands are tucked; they continue the same irregular vertical striped pattern in navy, white, red, and muted blue tones. The pant silhouette is relaxed straight to slightly wide, full-length and long enough to break softly over the feet, creating a fluid tailored line. Open-toe heeled sandals peek out beneath the hems, with red-and-cream striped straps that echo the color palette of the outfit. The styling reads coordinated, textured, and tailored, with strong verticality from the matching stripe pattern and a polished runway mood.
